trust_decision.summary: Coerced objects must be created with a null prototype so untrusted keys such as `__proto__` stay own data properties, and sub-schemas must be resolved only from own keys of the schema shape (never from Object.prototype); enforced in the object and record branches of the zod v3 and zod v4 smart-coercion plugins.

landing_point.why: The advisory names @orpc/zod smart coercion, so a reader first opens the exported ZodSmartCoercionPlugin (packages/zod/src/coercer.ts:31) and finds the plain `{}` that untrusted keys are copied into.

fix_sites.entry_point: ZodSmartCoercionPlugin from @orpc/zod, installed as a StandardHandler plugin (clientInterceptors)
ZodSmartCoercionPlugin from @orpc/zod, installed as a StandardHandler plugin (clientInterceptors)
experimental_ZodSmartCoercionPlugin from @orpc/zod/zod4, installed as a StandardHandler plugin
experimental_ZodSmartCoercionPlugin from @orpc/zod/zod4, installed as a StandardHandler plugin

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The zod4 plugin is exported as `experimental_ZodSmartCoercionPlugin` from the separate `@orpc/zod/zod4` subpath, is marked @deprecated in favour of the Smart Coercion Plugin, and the report/example exercises the zod v3 `ZodSmartCoercionPlugin`, so a solver can argue the deprecated experimental path is not covered.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Keys that collide with Object.prototype members (`constructor`, `toString`) must survive as ordinary own data and be coerced through the catchall, unknown keys must keep passing through unchanged, and an own `__proto__` key must stay an own data property rather than be dropped; a fix that skips/deletes prototype-named keys or strips `__proto__` breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: plain object with an own `__proto__` key (as produced by JSON.parse / the request body parser) coerced by z.object
record input with arbitrary string keys, including `__proto__`, coerced by z.record
extra key named after an Object.prototype member (`constructor`, `toString`) on z.object with no matching shape key, with and without catchall
unknown/extra keys on z.object that must keep passing through and be catchall-coerced

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The same object-coercion mechanism in the sibling @orpc/json-schema package (including its allOf/anyOf/$ref merge paths), which builds objects from untrusted keys.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the identical job in a second package and received the same null-prototype/hasOwn treatment one commit earlier (#1726), so a maintainer adding a new coercion branch there could easily reintroduce a plain `{}` copy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A keyed output branch (e.g. record/intersection/map-with-string-keys) that assembles a result object from input keys inside the same coercion function.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The existing ZodRecord branch is already the same sink as the ZodObject branch; a maintainer adding another keyed zod type would copy the same `newObj[key] = value` pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The JSON transport's serializer copying every key of the data object into a fresh `{}` (`for (const k in data) json[k] = ...`).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is the same 'copy untrusted keys into an empty object' shape one layer away in the RPC transport, so a maintainer hardening transports after this advisory could plausibly write it there too.

O10_build.toolchain: pnpm@11.10.0 workspace monorepo, unbuild for package builds, vitest 3.2, TypeScript 5.9
O10_build.project_tests: packages/zod/src/coercer.test.ts and packages/zod/src/zod4/coercer.{test,structure,native,rest,combination}.test.ts, table-driven via packages/zod/tests/shared.ts; run with `pnpm vitest run`

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace `{}` with `new NullProtoObj()` only in the non-deprecated zod v3 object branch that the report's example exercises, leaving the record branch, the deprecated zod4 plugin and the `Object.hasOwn(shape, k)` sub-schema lookup untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: Outside this advisory's protection, `packages/shared/src/object.ts:67-70` (`clone`) and the JSON serializers at `packages/client/src/adapters/standard/rpc-json-serializer.ts:113-125` and `packages/openapi-client/src/adapters/standard/openapi-json-serializer.ts:49-62` also copy keys into a plain `{}`; not pursued.
